pages.text: Right-click after placing to obtain one Ascension Cake Slice.$(br)Grants the eater:$(br)$(li)66 seconds of Nourishment$(li)66 seconds of The Pale Messenger$(li)66 seconds of Resistance IV$(li)66 seconds of Strength X$(li)66 seconds of Luck X$(br2)When a The End ritual is completed within 10 blocks, the cake turns into a The-End Cake, and only the ritual's caster may take from it.
